code:
SELECT d.fiscal_week,
  SUM(f.employee_discount_amount) / SUM(f.gross_amount) AS discount_rate
FROM dw.fact_sales f
JOIN dw.dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dw.dim_date d  ON d.date_key = f.date_key
WHERE s.store_id = 'ST06' AND d.full_date BETWEEN @FourWeeksAgo AND @Today
GROUP BY d.fiscal_week;
caption: 7-11% every single week -- not one unusual week dragging an average.

Store 06's discount rate has averaged 9.1% of gross sales over
four weeks, vs. 1.4% for the other 13 stores -- consistent week
over week. I don't have visibility into why. Flagging the pattern
and the numbers so you can decide how to look into it.
